mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weekly_goal wg WHERE wg.user_id = #{userId} AND wg.achieved = 1 ) AS totalAchievements, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ll.course_id) FROM learning_lesson ll JOIN ( SELECT user_id, course_id, MAX(accuracy) AS max_accuracy FROM assessment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id, course_id ) ar ON ar.user_id = ll.user_id AND ar.course_id = ll.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND ll.status = 2 AND ar.max_accuracy >= 0.8 ) AS certificatesEarned, ( SELECT c.name FROM learning_lesson ll JOIN course c ON c.id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sections FROM course_section GROUP BY course_id ) cs ON cs.course_id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, course_id, MAX(accuracy) AS max_accuracy FROM assessment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id, course_id ) ar ON ar.user_id = ll.user_id AND ar.course_id = ll.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND NOT (ll.status = 2 AND COALESCE(ar.max_accuracy, 0) >= 0.8) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ar.max_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(ar.max_accuracy * 100) WHEN COALESCE(cs.total_sections, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) * 100 / cs.total_sections) END DESC, ll.latest_learn_time DESC, ll.update_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS certificationName, COALESCE(( SELECT CASE WHEN ar.max_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(ar.max_accuracy * 100) WHEN COALESCE(cs.total_sections, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) * 100 / cs.total_sections) END FROM learning_lesson ll JOIN course c ON c.id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS total_sections FROM course_section GROUP BY course_id ) cs ON cs.course_id = ll.course_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, course_id, MAX(accuracy) AS max_accuracy FROM assessment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id, course_id ) ar ON ar.user_id = ll.user_id AND ar.course_id = ll.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND NOT (ll.status = 2 AND COALESCE(ar.max_accuracy, 0) >= 0.8) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ar.max_accuracy IS NOT NULL THEN FLOOR(ar.max_accuracy * 100) WHEN COALESCE(cs.total_sections, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) * 100 / cs.total_sections) END DESC, ll.latest_learn_time DESC, ll.update_time DESC LIMIT 1 ), 0) AS certificationProgress
